title: Did not peel long strips off red potatoes, and my yams!
text:
Did not peel long strips off red potatoes, and my yams!. This looks like a nice peeler.
Has a fat short non slip handle.

I have another hand peeler with a different handle, that is slim and wider, so this is a bit different for me.
I havd slim hands, long fingers. I found this was not as comfortable for me as my slimmer peeler is, and this did not
Take long strips of skin off my yams, and large red potatoes!

product_metadata.title: Frigidaire 11FFSLTN01 ReadyCook Slotted Turner
features: Easily flip, stir, lift and serve meals.
Tool rest lifts utensil head from touching the counter, helps keep the kitchen surface clean.
BPA free, dishwasher safe. Safe to use with all cookware.
description: Easily flip, stir, lift and serve meals with the Frigidaire Ready Cook Slotted Turner. The slotted turner is heat resistant up to 425°F/218°C. Features a non-slip tool rest that lifts utensil head from touching the kitchen counter. Made of Nylon, BPA free and dishwasher safe. Safe to use with all cookware.
